name: Bongusta
address: 8645 NW 61st St, Miami, FL 33166, United States
address_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js live read); the truck is parked at a fixed night-spot location named on Maps as 'Located in: Frank Cachapas Doral'.
phone_source: Google Business Profile, also printed directly on the truck's own signage (visible in gmaps-4.jpg, assets/raw).
language_evidence: All usable verbatim Google reviews (Katiuska Lemoine, The Ritero Burger, Giuliana A., Jose Manuel Rivas Roa, Kent Wong) are written in English despite the Venezuelan food/branding, so English was used as the site's primary language.
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website field). Domain checks: bongustafoodtruck.com, bongustaburger.com, bongustamiami.com all return no DNS/connection (curl: no response). bongusta.com DOES return HTTP 200 but resolves to a GoDaddy 'this domain is for sale' parked lander (forsale.godaddy.com/forsale/bongusta.com), confirmed via curl on the redirect target, not this business's site. WebSearch for 'Bongusta burger food truck Miami' surfaced no official site or social profile.

social_media.evidence: The truck's own side panel (gmaps-4.jpg) shows '@BONGUSTA BURGER' printed next to small Facebook and Instagram glyph icons and an Uber Eats icon, so social accounts likely exist under some handle variant of 'bongustaburger'. However WebSearch for 'Bongusta burger food truck Miami instagram facebook' and '@bongustaburger' returned no indexed, verifiably-matching profile, so no handle is used anywhere on the site or in the dm_message to avoid linking to an unverified account.

email_search_note: No email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), no Facebook/Instagram page could be verified to check its About section, no linktree/poplme in evidence. Outreach channel is phone/call only.

google_business.hours: Mon-Wed 7 PM-1 AM, Thu 7 PM-1 AM, Fri-Sat 7 PM-3 AM, Sun 7 PM-1 AM (live GBP read via gmaps_detail.js)

services.note: No published menu or prices found anywhere online (typical for a food truck without its own site). Dish names below are real, taken from Google review text (serviceMentions: burgers in 9 reviews, pepito in 3, arepas in 2, hot dog in 3, mixed pepito in 3) and from the truck's own exterior signage photo. No prices are invented anywhere on the site; copy uses 'ask for pricing at the truck' framing instead.
items: Bongusta Burger (double beef, bacon, melted cheddar, house sauce, shoestring fries in the bun) - most-mentioned item, 9 reviews
Pepito (griddled steak, sweet plantain, egg, ham, melted cheese on French bread; mixed version also offered) - mentioned in 3 reviews
Venezuelan Hot Dog (jumbo hot dog loaded with shoestring fries, shredded cheese, house sauces) - mentioned in 3 reviews, called 'the best Venezuelan hot dogs' by a reviewer
Sausage Fries (fries topped with grilled sausage coins, mayo and ketchup)

reviews_verbatim.name: The Ritero Burger
reviews_verbatim.text: Great street food, the burgers are amazing and the hot dogs are excellent, and the service is great too. I highly recommend them!

reviews_verbatim.name: Giuliana A.
reviews_verbatim.text: The best Venezuelan hot dogs, without a doubt!

reviews_not_used.name: Kent Wong
reviews_not_used.text: Terrible food. He tipped himself after i gave him my credit card. I don't even know what to say. Shocked.
reviews_not_used.reason: Negative outlier, not representative, omitted (never fabricated a counter-narrative either).

reviews_not_used.name: Jose Manuel Rivas Roa
reviews_not_used.text: The food was okay, but nothing on the menu was available except hot dogs...

All 10 were genuine, non-stock, non-text-overlay food/truck photos (one, gmaps-8.jpg, showed gloved hands holding a cut sandwich and was excluded from the gallery as slightly busy/less premium, kept only in assets/raw as research evidence). gmaps-2.jpg is a byte-identical duplicate of gmaps-1.jpg, not used twice.
brand_vibe: Warm amber/mustard-gold palette derived via scripts/palette_shift.py (target hue ~42 deg) from the real truck branding: a bright yellow truck body with a brown/mustard 'Bongusta' logo roundel and red Venezuelan-flag accents.
